tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// khro bo'i rgyal po sme brtsegs la bstod pa'i sngags bzhugs/

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ kro dha bhu ra ku ma ku ṭa rā dza s+t+rotra man+t+ra/ bod skad du/ khro bo'i rgyal po sme brtsegs la bstod pa'i sngags/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ bhu ra kuṃ ma hā pra ṇa ya/ bhur tsi bhur ki ma ṇā si/ u tsustsa kro dha hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal bstod// khro la khros pas khro bo che// sangs rgyas sangs rgyas sngar sangs rgyas// chos sku longs sku sprul pa'i sku// sme brtsegs zhes bya bdag phyag 'tshal// bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar dbus na// pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs// ljang nag chen po sme ba can// zhal gsum pa la phyag drug ste// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus ljang ba// spyan gsum 'jigs pa'i mche ba gcig /mi gtsang bdud rtsi sman bzhin gsol// g.yas par rdo rje ral gri bsnams// g.yon par zhags pa lcags kyu'o// tha ma sdig mdzub thugs kar bsnol// sme gtsang med pa'i las dag brtson// gdug pa sbrul gyis dbu lus brgyan// 'jigs sngangs med par btul zhugs spyod// khro rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// mi gtsang ba ni gtsang bar mdzad// khro rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'jigs pa kun las skyob par mdzad// khro rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// nad dang rims las srung bar mdzad// khro rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ mi gtsang zas dang mi gtsang gos// thams cad sel bar byed pa'i mchog /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin gdon// thams cad ma lus dga' bar mdzad// nad dang rims dang dal yams rnams// srung ba'i las mdzad phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag la srung ba mdzad du gsol/ mi gtsang ba rnams gtsang bar mdzad// sme ba rnams ni ming smer mdzad// lci ba rnams ni yang bar mdzad// dog pa yangs pa mdzad la bstod// khro bo'i rgyal po sme brtsegs khyed// sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis brlabs// gang dag khyod la mos brten rnams// lus bde sems bde dbang po bde// bde ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// lus dag sems dag dbang po dag

/dag pa'i lta la phyag 'tshal lo// lus gtsang sems gtsang dbang po gtsang*/ gtsang ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// lus dwang sems dwang dbang po dwang*// dwang ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// lus gsal sems gsal dbang po gsal// gsal ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// lha klu yi dwags 'dre srin sogs// gnod sbyin 'byung po sa 'di thos na// sdug bsngal zhi nas bde bar 'gyur// gangs rgyud bzhin du dkar bar 'gyur// shel dkar bzhin du gtsang bar 'gyur// me long bzhin du gsal bar 'gyur// nam mkha' bzhin du dwangs bar 'gyur// sa dang mkha' la 'khod pa yi// lha klu la sogs sde brgyad kun// dge ba'i bsam pas 'khod 'gyur te// gzhan la ma gnod zhi bar mdzod// khro bo'i rgyal po sme brtsegs la bstod pa'i sngags so// zhus dag /sarba maṅga laṃ// dge'o/// /
